description.value: Pizza 24 Chilliwack has been serving the Fraser Valley since 2010, offering specialty and classic pizzas through takeout and delivery from their Sardis-area location on Vedder Road. The menu spans timeless pepperoni-style pies to Greek- and Italian-inspired fusion options, with online ordering and real-time order tracking available.

No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
